answer_1.quote: We propose a simple two-stage method: over-sampling and post-evaluation (SimOAP) to improve the coherence and consistency in persona-based dialogue.

answer_2.quote: For fluency assessment, we use perplexity (PPL) to evaluate the fluency of responses. ... For consistency assessment, we use consistency score (C).

answer_3.quote: The RoBERTa is fine-tuned on DialogueNLI ... used to compute the possibility of entailment between candidate responses and persona sentences.

answer_4.quote: Three graduate students with good English skills are asked to rate the quality of responses from fluency (Flue), coherence (Cohe), informativeness (Info), and consistency (Cons).
answer_4.guideline: Fluency, coherence, and informativeness are scored on a scale of 1 to 5 ... consistency is 0 or 1.
